en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a large, ornate corner building with arched windows and balconies in a European architectural style. In front of the building stands an elaborate monument with a central standing figure on a tall pedestal and several seated figures around the base. People in early-20th‑century clothing are gathered around the monument and in front of the building. Printed text in Hungarian appears at the top of the image indicating the city and the name of the building and statue.
